components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 1px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.006 250)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.006 250)); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.2 0.02 255)); text-decoration: none; outline: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } a.ds-cell:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.955 0.005 250)); } a.ds-cell:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.55 0.15 255)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-cell-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.5 0.02 255)); } .ds-dot-warn { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--warning, oklch(0.75 0.16 75)); } .ds-lead { font-size: 2.625rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fig { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cell-note { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.5 0.02 255)); }

components.css: .ds-terms { margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 12px; } .ds-term { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6rem minmax(0, 1fr) 13rem; align-items: center; column-gap: 16px; } .ds-ref { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-track { position: relative; height: 20px; } .ds-axis { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: var(--border, oklch(0.9 0.006 250)); } .ds-bar { position: absolute; top: 50%; height: 6px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.5 0.02 255)) 45%, transparent); } .ds-notice { position: absolute; top: 2px; height: 16px; width: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--warning, oklch(0.75 0.16 75)); } .ds-today { position: absolute; top: -2px; height: 24px; width: 1px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.2 0.02 255)) 60%, transparent); } .ds-dates { text-align: right; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.5 0.02 255)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cap { display: flex; gap: 20px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.5 0.02 255)); } .ds-cap > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-key-notice { width: 2px; height: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--warning, oklch(0.75 0.16 75)); }

narrative.overview:
LeaseGuard is the signed logbook kept at a centre management office: every lease term, monitoring event, message approval and change shows who signed it off and when, and what still waits on a person. The system is deliberately limited to type, palette, density and one signature move. A deep ink-blue rail (the LeaseGuard blue, darkened) owns the shell; the work area is plain white; the original blue appears only on actions and selection; state colours live only inside status marks.

Density is office density: a property manager at a desk in daylight, all day, reading figures they must trust. Sections are ruled with hairlines rather than boxed, figures are tabular, and hierarchy comes from scale contrast (one large lead figure per strip) rather than from colour or weight piling. Motion is quiet: one easing curve, short durations, no decorative animation.

The system refuses the category default of a grey sidebar over rows of identical stat cards.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-blue rail shell, white work area, LeaseGuard blue reserved for actions and selection.
IBM Plex Sans throughout, tabular figures in every table, date and amount.
Hairline-ruled sections and stat strips; no card per record.
The sign-off mark (initials disc and date, or an open dashed ring when pending) as the recurring signature.
Status as a dot plus text, never a pill.
The page name lives in the top bar; the body never repeats it as a visible title.
Lease terms drawn to exact scale, with the renewal-notice deadline marked.

rules.name: The Binding Blue Rule
rules.body: `--primary` is the original LeaseGuard blue and is not to be retuned, re-hued or replaced. The owner has reverted palette changes twice.

rules.name: The Quarantine Rule
rules.body: State colours appear only inside status marks (dots, rings, ticks). Text stays foreground; only a non-zero danger figure takes colour, because amber on white is too faint to read as text.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: Ink belongs to the rail. The work area is white; never put ink-blue panels in page content.

rules.name: The Ledger Figures Rule
rules.body: Every table is `tabular-nums` by default; any amount, date or count outside a table carries `tabular-nums` explicitly.

rules.name: The Scale Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from the lead figure's size against quiet 0.875rem body. No headings above 1rem in the page body, and no visible page title (it lives in the top bar; the `h1` is screen-reader only).

rules.name: The Italic Helper Rule
rules.body: Helper text under fields and settings is always 0.75rem italic in Pencil Grey. This is deliberate and consistent; do not mix in upright helper text.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Each view has exactly one primary (filled blue) button; every other action is outline or ghost.

rules.name: The Hidden Scrollbar Rule
rules.body: Scrollbars are always hidden (`scrollbar-width: none` and `*::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }`); content still scrolls by wheel, touch and keyboard.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: No shadows on page content. If something must read as separate, rule it with a hairline.

dos: Do use `--primary` (the original LeaseGuard blue) for actions and selection only, and keep its value unchanged.
Do keep ink-blue (`--rail`) to the sidebar; nest rail content inside the `.rail` scope so tokens remap automatically.
Do show status as a 6px dot plus text, and anything awaiting a person with the sign-off mark or the open approval ring.
Do give each view exactly one primary button; everything else is outline or ghost.
Do rule sections and lists with 1px hairlines and group a strip of figures in one 10px frame.
Do lead a stat strip with one lead figure (2.625rem semibold) when one number matters most.
Do set all figures tabular and format dates `dd MMM yyyy` (en-ZA) and amounts in ZAR.
Do write helper text in 0.75rem italic Pencil Grey, consistently.
Do keep scrollbars hidden everywhere (`scrollbar-width: none` and `*::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }`).
Do use the shared `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` curve at about 160ms, and honour reduced motion.
Do show only figures that come from the API; show a dash or an empty state when there is no data.
donts: Don't put a visible page title in the page body; the page name lives in the top bar.
Don't use pill badges for status.
Don't colour text with state hues, except a non-zero danger figure.
Don't box each record or each figure in its own card, and don't build rows of identical stat cards.
Don't add shadows to page content; shadows are for menus, popovers, dialogs and sheets.
Don't make anything rounder than its container (10px maximum on frames).
Don't invent figures, sample data, testimonials or sequential entry numbers; entry numbers and a per-property log are not built because the data does not support them yet.
